name: Mailfully Free
free_limit: 3,000 outbound emails per month, 100 inbound emails per month at a mailfully.app address, up to 100 recipients per day, up to 3 sending domains, and 30-day logs. Free sending stops at the monthly cap.
watch_out: Cloud-hosted email API; no credit card required for the free plan. Custom-domain inbound receiving, higher quotas and overage billing require a paid plan. Sending a live email requires domain verification; larger sending volumes may require account review. Free plan is capped rather than automatically billed for extra sends.
